templates.description: Print QS config, registry and GHX diagnostics without modifying global configuration.
steps: Resolve QS home, cache and project config paths from the current environment.
Run qs doctor and qs ghx doctor in JSON mode when available.
Optionally search a registry manifest to check registry discoverability.

qs_diagnostic_query.description: Query used when a registry search is requested.

qs_home_path.description: QS home path to display when QS_HOME is not set.

qs_project_config.description: Project config path to check from the current working directory.

qs_registry_source.description: Optional registry manifest source to search; leave empty to skip registry search.

templates.description: Install or upgrade the QS CLI from a published GitHub release into a user-writable bin directory.
steps: Detect the current OS and CPU architecture.
Download the selected QS release asset from GitHub.
Install the executable as qs and print the detected version.

qs_install_dir.description: Directory where the qs executable should be installed.

qs_repo.description: GitHub owner/repo containing QS release assets.

qs_version.description: QS release tag, or latest for the latest GitHub release.

templates.description: Run a local QS smoke check against a repo, search index and recipe render output.
steps: Verify the qs executable is available.
Search the repo through the local repo source.
Render the recipe to a reviewable smoke output script.

qs_bin.description: QS executable to use for the smoke check.

qs_recipe_path.description: Recipe path rendered by the smoke check.

qs_repo_path.description: Repo path inspected and searched by the smoke check.

qs_search_query.description: Search query used to verify local repo discovery.

qs_smoke_output.description: Output path for the rendered smoke script.
